title: NASA's SpaceX Crew-11 Isolated Launch View - Helicopter 4K 60fps
description: NASA’s coverage of the countdown and launch of the Crew-11 mission to the International Space Station. NASA astronauts Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke, JAXA astronaut Kimiya Yui and Roscosmos cosmonaut Oleg Platonov launched in a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft named Endeavour atop a Falcon 9 rocket to begin their long-duration stay aboard the orbiting laboratory.
